selection_rationale: All 66 provisional subskills are structurally reachable but assessment_target_status remains UNBOUND by contract. Binding deterministic assessment targets can proceed from the exact capability statements without fabricating SME approval, psychometric validity, real learner outcomes, or resolution of uncertain prerequisite candidates. Unresolved prerequisite semantics remain a separate evidence-adjudication lane and are not silently promoted.
assessment_target_contract_work: Define one machine-readable assessment-target schema for a provisional subskill: exact subskill identity, parent requirement, capability statement, preserved cognitive level, evidence/input class, response/action class, deterministic scoring assertions, abstention/insufficient-evidence behavior, and validation status.
Require each target to test the capability statement rather than merely repeat the source title.
Preserve source-version provenance and forbid newer-standard substitution.
Do not infer psychometric validity, item difficulty, discrimination, population validity, learner mastery, retention, transfer, workplace effectiveness, SME approval, or certification equivalence.
Allow synthetic deterministic fixtures only to prove software/schema behavior; label them non-human and non-effectiveness evidence.
After contract validation, bind all 66 subskills in deterministic source order using bounded batches and exact-SHA hosted validation.

protected_parallel_gap.rule: Assessment-target binding must neither require nor imply canonical resolution of uncertain prerequisite candidates.

stop_condition: A deterministic assessment-target schema and validator exist, exact frozen/capability provenance is enforced, synthetic positive and negative fixtures prove contract behavior, prohibited evidence claims remain UNOBSERVED, and a first bounded source-order target-binding batch can execute without guessing semantic prerequisites or human outcomes.
